name: basis-v4
plus: sqrt(3) = 3^(1/2) as explicit parity factor (algebraic, not a generator): multiplies exactly the monomials with an odd number of Im-type factors (pi, Cl2, Cl4, Im Li3(i/sqrt3), Im Li4(i/sqrt3), the three ImG, T111bar4) -- verified on every term

conventions.heads: vakint::Integral(f, vakint::Interval(x,a,b), ...) first interval outermost; vakint::LoopIntegral(D, f, k(1..L)) = prod_i int d^D k_i/pi^(D/2) f (Euclidean); vakint::SeriesCoefficient(f, x, 0, n) = coefficient of x^n (not the derivative); vakint::EuclideanDot
